hb_joint_rise_fall_occupancy.quantity: occupancy of jointly rising-HbO / falling-HbR slope words

hb_x_joint_rise_fall_fraction.quantity: fraction of cells with original HbO slope > 0 AND HbR slope < 0

hb_centroid_signed_opposition.quantity: HbO slope minus HbR slope (not a conjunction)

hb_x_signed_opposition.quantity: HbO slope minus HbR slope (not a conjunction)

posterior_alpha_enriched_occupancy.rule: centroid band fraction > assignment-count-weighted training mean + tie_tolerance

frontal_theta_enriched_occupancy.rule: centroid band fraction > assignment-count-weighted training mean + tie_tolerance

primary_sign_flip.assumption: Independent subject contrasts symmetric about zero under the null; ties included. Not a trial-label randomization test.

contract.events: Publisher MA subtraction vs explicitly labelled BL, not pre-event or intertrial rest. The verified downstream-v2 owner supplies event identity and separate EEG/Hb clocks only.
contract.input: Same b277a356 disjoint G0 30-s score-crop join, all seven positions and all score/observation ticks required in [marker+2,+10). G0 X/frozen position SD only; no downstream arrays, S/O or teacher.
contract.variables: Four 2-s cells; equally average declared sites and time cells per trial. EEG fractions are codec-native untapered non-DC power, not absolute alpha/theta power. Hb uses two OLS slopes in the same scaled-X units/s; neither levels nor an absolute concentration difference.
contract.priors: Directional hypotheses about external task labels, not physiology assigned to initial IDs. Use only supported original TRAIN physical centroids. Keep sparse/empty word groups and their zero occupancies; signed opposition is always a separate comparison, never a replacement primary.
contract.pairing: Condition balancing without subsampling: separately mean all retained MA and all BL events within the same session, subtract BL from MA, average eligible sessions per subject, then subjects equally. Paired events are all trials in qualifying sessions, not one-to-one matches. Never pair across sessions. Incomplete subjects remain in denominators; paired-subset estimates are distinguished from the full registered-cohort estimand.
contract.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% subject-bootstrap percentiles (inverted empirical CDF), conditional on the frozen data/words/support; exact n**n ordered draws in validation, fixed-seed MC in train. No interval for fewer than two paired subjects. Only the complete validation primary has a two-sided sign-symmetry test. Other phases/metrics and all train results are exploratory, not multiplicity controlled. A zero-width interval for a constant endpoint is not evidence of equivalence.
contract.limits: Offline, previously examined public development cohort; native EEG and parent-referenced, subject-scaled Hb (including validation). Possible cue, systemic, eye/muscle, order and selection effects. These contrasts are neither independent biological replicates per cell nor proof of cortical source, causality, real-time decoding, or protected/test generalization.
